messages:
sara: FYI customer ACME (acct: acme-inc) reports console shows a refund credit (~$1,200) but their service key calls are still being billed. Refund ID: R-9987. Can someone take a look?

billing-bot: Refund R-9987 processed for org org_421. Amount: 1200.00 USD. Applied to org balance. (txn: tx_55f)

andrew: thanks. do we have the project_id or service key they use? often this is a project->servicekey mapping issue after migrations.

sara: project_id: proj_acme_prod, service_key: sk_live_AbC123. Customer pasted screenshot showing dashboard credit balance +1200.

maria: grabbing metering for that service key now. can you confirm which timestamp they saw the credit?

sara: they saw it ~2025-11-02T10:12Z (from their screenshot).

maria: quick check: curl to our internal usage endpoint showed continuing token usage and no credit applied to service_key. Running:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_AbC123" https://internal-api.redwood.infra/v1/usage?from=2025-10-15&to=2025-11-05
```
Response snippet:
```
{
  "service_key": "sk_live_AbC123",
  "usage_tokens": 452300,
  "credits_applied": 0,
  "billing_account": "acct_legacy_77"
}
```

maria: billing_account there is acct_legacy_77 — so usage is still getting billed to a legacy account, not the org-level balance where refund was applied.

andrew: that matches a known migration edgecase: org credit was added to new org billing account (acct_org_421) but proj_acme_prod still pointed at acct_legacy_77. I can trigger a billing resync to reassign recent usage to the org balance. Do we have approval to adjust metering records back to the refund window?

sara: customer says yes, they want the refund applied to live usage. they're on a paid plan.

andrew: ok running resync for project proj_acme_prod to acct_org_421 for window 2025-10-01..2025-11-05. Command:
```
internal-cli billing-resync --project proj_acme_prod --from 2025-10-01 --to 2025-11-05 --target-acct acct_org_421
```
deploy-bot: started job job_87321 (billing-resync) by andrew. Logs will stream to /var/log/billing-resync/job_87321.log

maria: watching logs. seeing entries that match service_key usage being re-attributed. sample log line:
```
2025-11-02T10:15:23Z INFO reassign usage_id=usg_99811 from acct_legacy_77 -> acct_org_421
```

andrew: job completed. summary: 452,300 tokens re-attributed, net applied credit from org balance = 1,200.00 USD (covers usage through 2025-11-03). Remaining charge outstanding: 0.

billing-bot: Resync job job_87321 completed. Adjusted 47 records. Credits now reflected on service_key sk_live_AbC123 usage.

andrew: I also added a short-term alert to catch project->billing-account drift for projects migrated in last 6 months. Filed follow-up GH: infra/billing#412.

sara: forwarded confirmation to the customer and asked them to verify dashboard and API billing. they replied: "Looks good, charges stopped and credit shows in API usage. Thanks!" :thumbsup:

maria: closing thread unless y'all want us to keep monitoring — i'll leave the resync audit log attached to the ticket.

andrew: all good from billing side. closing.

sara: closing on support side.
